text:
alex: Heads-up — Acme folks landing earlier than we thought, arriving 14:45 for the 15:00 sync. Can front desk badge them on arrival?
frontdesk-bot: @alex noted. Please add guest names to the visitor list so we can pre-print badges. Kiosk printer A is online. :printer:
alex: Added names in the spreadsheet: Leah Chen, Raj Patel, and Marco Ruiz. Sheet link: https://redwood.docs/visitors/acme-0426
people-ops: Thanks Alex — we'll have temporary badges ready at Lobby Kiosk. Remind guests to bring an ID for verification. Also, if anyone needs a guest parking pass let us know (limited spots).
jamal: I'll meet them at the lobby at 14:40 and bring a stack of visitor stickers for team members. Also, can we reserve the glass room on 4 for the 15:00 slot?
emily: Glass room booked, switching my desk for a hotdesk near the conference zone so there's space for the demo setup. @tony can you help move the extra monitor from 6A?
ton y: Yep I can swing by with the monitor at 14:20. Leaving it by the door of 4G. :muscle:
frontdesk-bot: Note: A courier just dropped off a package addressed to "Jamal / Acme" — oversized box, marked fragile. It's in Locker L3. Jamal, please collect before 14:30 if you need it in the meeting. :package:
jamal: Got it, heading down now. If anyone wants the demo dongles, they're inside that box.
people-ops: Quick reminder for hosts: if guests need network access, hand out the visitor wifi card (expires in 8 hours). For any air-gapped demo material, please coordinate with security.
alex: One last thing — Could we get catering for 4? Small charcuterie and two vegetarian boxes. Budget approved by @product. :+1:
people-ops: Ordered from Bloom & Co, ETA 14:50. Dietary labels on each box. We'll place them in the pantry; please inform guests snacks are allergy-aware.
emily: If anyone's arriving early and needs a seat, I freed up a bench in the lounge. Otherwise there's a high-top near 4G.
jamal: Perfect. Thanks everyone. @frontdesk-bot let reception know I'll escort them in. :wave:
frontdesk-bot: Reception acknowledged. Badges will be on the kiosk under "Pre-printed". Reminder to hosts: return temporary badges to the dropbox after the meeting.
people-ops: Logging this as a note on today's visitor log for badge reconciliation. Have a good meeting! :tada:
